games.name: Flood Escape: Classic
games.desc:
Locked in a flooding facility, you and your team must work together to push buttons, find the way out, crack the code and escape before the flood takes you!

Flood Escape Classic started development in September 2011, and is what kickstarted the Flood Escape series.

FEC persisted through many of Roblox's fundamental changes; Mobile Support, Dynamic Lighting, Filtering Enabled and many more.

While the game doesn't get updated often now due to focus on FE2, FEC's continued community and player count shows that the game continues to offer a solid experience for obby enthusiasts.

games.name: A Silent Town
games.desc:
Monsters called "Listeners" have invaded this town, they are blind creatures that have very big ears. You can not escape this town, all the exits are blocked off. You must survive for as long as you can!

- Search around the map for supplies to survive, buildings you spawn in usually have a lot of them!🧰
- Find a Hammer to build a base and block out any openings!🔨
- Survive against the Listeners for as long as you can!🕙
- Monsters can hear your voice with Voice-Chat!🔊
- Earn money to upgrade your stats permanently!💸

Becoming a Listener is free in VIP servers.
Be sure to like and favorite the game if you enjoy!
Your loadout is NOT meant to save, you lose it when you die or leave.

Game is inspired by "GEF", and the movie "A Quiet Place"
